enacted_by: Department of Consumer Affairs, Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution, Government of India

rules.title: Name and Complete Address of Manufacturer / Packer / Importer
rules.message_template: Manufacturer/Packer/Importer declaration for '{field}' is invalid or incomplete: '{actual}'. Must state complete postal address with locality, state, and 6-digit PIN code as required by Rule 6(1)(a).
rules.example_violation: Manufactured by ABC Confectionery, Sector 18, Gurugram (Missing mandatory 6-digit postal PIN code and complete physical manufacturing premises address).

rules.title: Generic or Common Name of Commodity
rules.message_template: Generic or common commodity name for '{field}' is missing or insufficient: detected '{actual}'. Package must prominently declare recognizable generic commodity name under Rule 6(1)(b).
rules.example_violation: Package prominently displays fancy brand trademark 'CrunchBlast Gold' but omits the mandatory generic commodity identity 'Potato Chips'.

rules.title: Net Quantity in Standard Metric Units
rules.message_template: Net quantity unit for '{field}' uses non-standard or illegal notation: '{actual}'. Only approved SI metric symbols ({allowed_units}) without pluralization are permitted under Rule 6(1)(c) and Rule 22.
rules.example_violation: Net weight declared as 'Net Weight: 500 gms' or '1 Kgs' instead of statutory SI metric symbols '500 g' or '1 kg' as required by Rule 22.

rules.title: Month and Year of Manufacture / Packing / Import
rules.message_template: Date of manufacture/packing/import for '{field}' has non-compliant format: '{actual}'. Must state month and year in approved statutory format (e.g. MM/YYYY or DD/MM/YYYY) as per Rule 6(1)(d).
rules.example_violation: Pre-packed box printed with 'Pkd Date: 2024' or 'Best Before 6 Months' lacking the mandatory specific calendar month and year.

rules.title: Maximum Retail Price (MRP) & Tax Inclusivity Mandate
rules.message_template: Maximum Retail Price (MRP) for '{field}' is absent, non-positive, or non-compliant: '{actual}'. Must be a valid retail price between {min_value} and {max_value} {currency} accompanied by mandatory '(incl. of all taxes)' clause under Rule 6(1)(e) and Rule 18.
rules.example_violation: Retail price stated as 'MRP Rs. 150.00' omitting the mandatory statutory phrase '(incl. of all taxes)', or price is completely absent.

rules.title: Consumer Care Details & Grievance Redressal Mechanism
rules.message_template: Consumer care declaration for '{field}' is incomplete: '{actual}'. Must provide contact designation/office, valid telephone/toll-free helpline number, and grievance email address as per Rule 6(1)(f).
rules.example_violation: Consumer helpline text states 'For customer queries email: support@brand.com' but lacks a statutory telephone or toll-free redressal helpline number.

rules.title: Country of Origin for Imported Commodities
rules.message_template: Country of origin declaration for '{field}' is missing on imported commodity: '{actual}'. Must explicitly state country of origin (e.g. 'Country of Origin: Spain') under Rule 27 and Rule 6(1)(n).
rules.example_violation: Imported Italian Olive Oil bottle lists local importer address in Mumbai but omits the mandatory statutory declaration 'Country of Origin: Italy'.

rules.title: Minimum Height of Numeral and Letters (Rule 8 Table 1)

brackets.description: Net quantity up to 50 g or ml: minimum font height 1.0 mm
Net quantity 50 g/ml to 100 g/ml: minimum font height 1.5 mm
Net quantity 100 g/ml to 200 g/ml: minimum font height 2.0 mm
Net quantity 200 g/ml to 500 g/ml: minimum font height 2.5 mm
Net quantity 500 g/ml to 1000 g/ml: minimum font height 4.0 mm
Net quantity above 1000 g or ml (1 kg / 1 l): minimum font height 6.0 mm

rules.message_template: Measured font height of {actual} mm for '{field}' is below the statutory requirement of {expected} mm for package size tier under Rule 8 Table 1.
rules.example_violation: Numerals for net quantity and MRP on a 1 kg flour pouch measure 1.8 mm, violating the statutory Table 1 requirement of minimum 6.0 mm font height.

rules.title: Mandatory Statutory Language (Hindi or English)
rules.message_template: Language '{actual}' for mandatory declaration '{field}' violates Rule 6(2). Declarations must be presented in either Hindi in Devanagari script or in English.
rules.example_violation: Package printed exclusively in Mandarin or German with no Hindi or English translation sold in the Indian domestic retail market.

rules.title: Principal Display Panel (PDP) Conspicuous Placement
rules.message_template: Mandatory declarations for '{field}' are positioned in an improper or obscured location: '{actual}'. Must be grouped conspicuously on the Principal Display Panel (PDP) under Rules 5 and 7.
rules.example_violation: Mandatory retail price and consumer care disclosures hidden under the crimped bottom fold seam rather than positioned prominently on the Principal Display Panel.

supplementary_rules.title: MRP Inclusive of All Taxes Mandate
supplementary_rules.message_template: MRP declaration '{actual}' for '{field}' fails to declare '(incl. of all taxes)' or 'inclusive of all taxes' as mandated by Rule 18.
supplementary_rules.example_violation: Price printed as 'MRP Rs 100' without the mandatory statutory phrase '(incl. of all taxes)'.

supplementary_rules.title: Standard Pack Quantity & Prohibition of Non-Standard Units
supplementary_rules.message_template: Non-standard unit notation '{actual}' used for '{field}'. Rule 22 strictly prohibits pluralization or colloquial abbreviations.
supplementary_rules.example_violation: Net weight written as '500 grams' or '500 gms' instead of statutory SI symbol '500 g'.
